what_happened: Dispatch's secondary scope item cites scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh:717-720 as a one-line WIRED_REPO detector addition site, but that script does not exist anywhere in this repo's working tree or git history -- only prose citations in task-abandon-mode.md and skill-todo/SKILL.md describe the hazard. Likely a stale cross-repo migration citation. Flagged in report rather than implemented as a guess.

Dispatch-embedded snapshot counts (task 177 whole-directory entry; 28 of 52 missing file_scope) were fully stale against the live validate-state.sh run: task 177 does not exist in this repo's state.json at all, and only 3 of 137 non-terminal tasks (567,568,607) are missing file_scope, not 28. Live Check 8 instead names projects 473 and 518. All recommendations in the report are based on the live run, per the dispatch's own warning.

Planning discovered scripts/backfill-file-scope.sh already exists and handles the automated half of defect 2; its --dry-run run cleanly explains why 567/568/607 remain absent (plan-less, deliberately left absent per its Decision 6), so the plan only has to cover the hand-declaration case the tool declines by design.

Dispatch description cites 'Check 9 (duplicates)' as enumerating the missing-file_scope defect; live validate-state.sh shows duplicates are Check 9 (already PASS) and the missing/null/empty defect is Check 10. Also, --strict cannot serve as this task's acceptance bar: it additionally promotes two out-of-scope Check 4 unknown-entry-field WARNs (audit_override, audit_verdict) to exit-blocking, so the plan's bar is per-check cleanliness on Checks 8/9/10 in base mode instead.

Phase 3's own Testing & Validation criterion ('grep -rn check-evidence-probes agent-system/ returns no hits') is broader than its Tasks/Scope Hypothesis, which scoped the phase narrowly to the two WIRED_REPO citation sites (confirmed via 'grep -rn WIRED_REPO agent-system/'). A broader grep for the literal string 'check-evidence-probes' surfaces 3 further pre-existing occurrences not in Phase 3's task list: agent-system/extensions/formal/context/project/logic/domain/ztime-no-finite-carrier-fmp.md:75 and agent-system/extensions/lean/context/project/lean4/domain/decidability-provenance.md:84 (both claim the nonexistent script 'guards'/'compile-checks' a substantive logic/Lean claim -- a different and more consequential class of false citation than the archival-hazard prose Phase 3 corrected), and agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json:24 (an external_scripts manifest entry declaring the script as an expected dependency). None of these were touched: fixing the two domain-file citations requires domain-specific judgment about what verification actually backs those claims (not a mechanical hazard-description correction), and the manifest entry's correct resolution (remove the dependency declaration, or determine the script was meant to be supplied by an extension not yet built) was not researched. Recorded as a follow-up recommendation rather than executed, consistent with the plan's own Non-Goal declining to build or chase the evidence-probe detector.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

Full gate set (verify-deploy.sh, 28 checks) and the full shell test suite (run-all.sh, 188 suites) both ran to completion against the live state after all three prior phases landed. Every finding attributed cleanly: the only non-pre-registered-EXPECTED failures (doc-lint x2, run-all.sh test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh NEW, whole-tree-orphan x2) all trace to task 601's own in-flight uncommitted new lint-script files not yet registered in manifest.json provides.scripts -- confirmed via git status/git log, none within task 531's declared file_scope. validate-state.sh Checks 8/9/10/11 and backfill-file-scope.sh --dry-run (0 plan-less) all confirm the remediation is complete and holding.

Task 531's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
